Stuck on a skip? Step-by-step voice guide with UPDATED skips: https://youtu.be/ESrrkdxD1fo
LATEST PATCH 1.0.1 Kuldra speedrun in RuneScape: Dragonwilds with the new skips that work after the patch. Get your Dragon armour fast with this route.

No commentary. Follow along step by step, or use the chapters to jump straight to the skip you need.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Start
0:18 Windstep to air anima
0:40 Soulscourge skip
1:17 Skip the black dragon
1:35 Skip the ENTIRE necromancer area (NEW)
2:40 Skip the ENTIRE poison area
3:04 Surge + phase dash past the abyssal demon
3:40 Skip the HARDEST part of the raid (NEW) (Even faster way is killing the Garou Thane in the air room through the gate with a melee weapon, getting air charged from killing him then windstepping up through the air doorway) - thanks  @Sir_Rebral  
5:20 Parkour section made easy
6:00 Elemental puzzle (NO MORE SKIP)
8:25 Skip the Kuldra fight in under a minute

GEAR & SETUP
- Fleet Foot Infusion: MUST BRING. Cuts sprinting stamina cost by 50%.
- Strong Tea: nice to have, restores +20 Rest.
- Mage weapon: 2-handed mage staff for killing the heart at the end.
- Armour: best mage gear you have.

What's your best Kuldra time? Drop it in the comments. And tell me which skip you didn't know about. If this saved you time, drop a subscribe, I'll be dropping an updated video with every patch! Trying to hit 500 subs!
